I’m ready to generate the Problem List Clinical Note, but I can’t proceed because the transcript and the DDx content weren’t provided.

Please paste the following:
- Transcript: the doctor-patient dialogue (as text)
- Differential Diagnosis (DDx): the DDx JSON or a clear list of differential diagnoses with any provided rationale

Tips:
- Include all clinically relevant details from the transcript (presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, ROS, PMH, allergies, medications, exam findings).
- Include any explicit management, treatment, or follow-up plans mentioned.
- For medications mentioned without dose/route/frequency, note the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If any inconsistencies arise between the transcript and DDx, I will mark “conflict noted.”

Once you provide those, I will deliver the structured Note with:
- Consult Summary (two-line)
- Problem List (Issues 1–3 with differential diagnoses from DDx where consistent)
- Medications, Allergies, Past Medical History, Social History, Preventative History
- Physical Examination
- Plan
- Quality checks with any conflicts or data gaps noted

Please paste the content in full and I’ll proceed.
